answer.market_read: No rule change this run. The shop race is the one that needs attention. Our class shop is 0.933 against inextro's 0.928, a gap of 0.005, which is under the 0.01 alert line. The gap hasn't grown, while the total lead widened to 0.020 only because Lee's shop dropped in the stars pool. By part: book is rank 1 with a lead of 149.3M that has been flat for an hour, so that percentile is already at its maximum. Revenue is rank 2, behind inextro by 2.20B and widening by about 12M per 15 min, so it can't be closed. Stars are rank 23 of 57 (4.60 vs inextro's 4.71), and that is the only part where our percentile can still rise, so it is the part I play for. Diagnosis of stars: after 22h of the A+B 72h warranty we are still at 4.60, so warranty alone isn't the lever (curator's cross-shop data agrees). Two measured causes remain. First, no-deal visits are rated (11-07: 668 visits at 2.75), and our walk-aways are large on price-competed sofas: Plana 4 had 216 in 6h, Agio 69, Goodmuse 66, Kiefer 45, Ward 44. Second, the settle gap: in 6h our seller closed 1518 deals but only 1171 settled, while the market refused just 3, so about 350 closes went unpaid. The curator's fit (0.21 × closes ≈ 323) points to grade C left unpaid by buyer kits. If those visits are rated, they cost stars and revenue together. Rivals: inextro sells warranted beds and sofas at x0.663, 98% warranted, 919 deals per 6h, and we supply 23% of its deals as a buyer. dragonash22's shop (0.749, 28% warranted, 4.39 stars) is the total-race threat if it adds a warranty; no jump this run. SKU level: there is no clear wrong setting. Kimchi G200e39a3 sold out (138/6h, 37% margin), but its surge of 1.106 fails L7's 1.08 limit. Apple is pinned at cover 2. The aged piles (Plana 3, Avenuel leather, Ace, Lumi) have restock targets below stock, so their covers don't bite, and cash of 489M is idle anyway. The Dahas bed fell from 43 per 24h to 3 per 6h with its ask already at the 0.85 floor, so per L108/L22 an ask move can't fix it. I hold all knobs. The 14:00 stars read and the C/unpaid split decide the real move: warranty_c or a price-for-stars change. The curator flags price vs stars as a human call, so it goes to the user.

lessons.text: Pick the shop part by rank headroom. With book at rank 1 (lead >100M, flat) and revenue at rank 2 behind a >1B gap, neither percentile can rise. Only stars (rank ~20+) can move class shop. Before any price or warranty move for stars, get the split of ratings by visit type (deal / walk-away / unpaid close) and by grade. Do not cut prices on a guess while a stars read is pending.
lessons.why: On 11-08 the A+B warranty left stars flat at 4.60 for 22h. Two causes remain open (rated walk-aways, unpaid C closes), and they need different knobs (ask vs warranty_c).

requests.text: Our settle gap is 1518 seller closes vs 1171 settles in 6h, with 3 refusals. Split the ~350 unsettled closes by grade (A/B/C), by warranty on the offer, and by buyer. Do those buyers leave a star rating on the unpaid visit, and at what mean?

Our star ratings over the last 24h by visit type: settled deal vs walk-away without an offer vs walk-away after an offer vs unpaid close. Give count and mean for each, and the 10 SKUs with the most low-star walk-away ratings. Is board stars lifetime or windowed?

watch.why: Kimchi sells out (138/6h, 54 sold-out asks, ~37% margin). Once surge is under L7's 1.08, a cover raise is allowed.
Mate is our top earner (106/6h, 197k/unit), holding 95 units (~5h). Under 30 means restock is falling behind the 6h rate.
Total lead is 0.020 over dragonash22. Wake me if we lose first.

notes_for_buyer: Shop race gap to inextro is 0.005 (class shop 0.933 vs 0.928). Our buyer supplies 23% of inextro's deals (208 of 919 per 6h), and each one adds to its book (rank 2, 149M behind us) and its stars count. The price case for inextro is real (0.41/deal, 88% conversion). At the 12:30 read, weigh the +0.03 bias against the shop gap as well as the 3M/h book-slide line, and cut it to 0 if the per-deal edge over psyoung82/Kiro729 is under ~0.02.

Our shop's settle gap is ~350 unpaid closes per 6h, likely grade C. If your kit's grade-C unpaid logic (130/24h) matches other kits', tell me which conditions make it leave a C receipt unpaid (warranty missing? price above some x?). That decides warranty_c.
